description: Coerce6: six independent quantizers in one module, each quantizing one polyphonic cable to the voltages arriving on another

inputs.text: The voltages that row quantizes to; with this jack unpatched the row uses the quantize voltages of the nearest patched row above it
The voltages to be quantized on that row

outputs.text: The quantized voltages of that row, one channel for each channel of its input, in the same order

notes: one quantize cable on the top row serves every row below it, because each row falls back to the nearest patched quantize input above it
the menu settings apply to all six rows at once
menu: Octave Fold — treats the quantizing voltages as repeating in every octave, so only the note matters
Restrict — quantizes to the given voltages themselves, octave and all
Up — rounds each input to the next quantizing voltage above it
Closest — rounds each input to the nearest quantizing voltage
Down — rounds each input down to the previous quantizing voltage
